blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Tariff is defined as the price charged for telecom services provided to consumers.
Spectrum represents the specific radio frequencies essential for establishing wireless communication.
Interconnection is the physical or logical linking of telecom networks allowing seamless cross-network communication.
Questions often ask for the specific term defined as 'radio frequencies used for wireless communication' (Spectrum).
Do not confuse Interconnection (linking different networks) with Spectrum (radio frequencies used for transmission).
